signature: void FortShippingLog(const UObject* WorldContextObject, const FString& InString, bool bLogAsWarning)

callees.0x141eef630: helper: formats the text (net-role/PIE tag, optional source prefix) and writes it to the log at Warning (3) or Log (5) verbosity
callees.0x144693810: PIE instance index of the world (native, only used on client worlds)

notes: Log category and PIE index source are MEDIUM: the native uses a Kismet-family category and a world-derived PIE index. Verbosity values 3 (Warning) and 5 (Log) are decoded from the native code.
